Subject: Re: Term transition — pricing and uplift options

Emma / Tessa —

Thanks — I pulled together three commercial options for the capacity uplift and SLO changes. High level:

Option A — Short-term burst: +40% committed capacity (3 months), no long-term price change, surcharge on overage.
Option B — Step-up commitment: +100% committed capacity, blended rate with 12-month amendment, lower per-token than overage.
Option C — Dedicated pool add-on: Dedicated capacity with SLA tiering (higher uptime SLA + support), annual commit.

I attached the spreadsheet that breaks down estimated monthly costs (pricing-options.xlsx). For speed, Option B is usually the best mix for customers moving from prototype to production — it gives predictable unit economics while allowing a staged capacity ramp.

Action items for kickoff: please confirm which option you’d like us to model (A/B/C) and we’ll publish a redlined amendment for procurement to review.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
